verdict.rationale: Evidence shows WooCommerce supports the Model Context Protocol so external AI assistants/tools can connect to and interact with a store (docs-14, docs-29, probe-3), but this is the reverse of the story — it makes WooCommerce a target for external agents, not a built-in AI assistant inside the product that a user can delegate tasks to. No dashboard-embedded assistant, chat interface, or agentic feature is documented anywhere in the evidence pack.
